`tests/test_ci_review_replay_contract.py::test_committed_semantic_review_uses_workflow_full_graph` fails at line 42. The generated `reports/semantic_review_20260921/resolution/current-review.json` currently binds `output/step7d-full-v1`; the unchanged `.github/workflows/qc-supported-kgx.yaml` produces `output/mim-kgx-710-full` in clean CI.

Local semantic integrity and supported-graph checks passed against the existing local graph, but that local path is not the CI-produced path. This is a generated evidence/configuration defect; the test correctly detects it.

Proposed correction when work resumes: export the full graph at the existing workflow path and rebuild the semantic review with the native builder using that exact path, preserving the prior diagnostic artifacts. Re-run the native mapping-review chain, semantic integrity, supported export/schema and the CI replay contract. Do not modify the workflow or test, and do not simply patch the JSON hash or bundle path without native regeneration. Confirm that dispositions, scientific assertions and the Step 7d snapshot pair remain unchanged.

The correction is within the native generated-evidence scope, but no remediation was started after the independent #1123 test-edit stop condition triggered. It remains a tracked finding for the next authorized continuation. Related scope: #901 and #1122.

Observed at Step 7d head `7d35035f6c521c69fad94f73381c6a6eb7251fff`. Full native suite: 5,069 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped, 33 warnings; exit 1. Receipt: `output/approved-plan-20261101T031134Z/logs/step7d-derived-full-suite-v1.json`; log SHA-256 `ff86736a2115bd2f8fb2031f1ee6e1b99955454a26357df396429a5f5e07df9f`.

The complete live open issue/PR inventory was searched for this defect before filing. No Step 7d push, PR or merge has occurred. The run is stopped under the user's explicit test-change restriction; no fix is applied by filing this issue. No production identity, snapshot cell, approval, assertion or workflow should be weakened to pass a test.
title: Step 7d semantic review binds a local graph path absent from clean CI
